sanskrit: indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇam agnim ūtaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe | rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
english: For aid we invoke Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa, Agni, the Marut host, and Aditi. O Vasus, liberal givers, as [one frees] a chariot from a difficult pass, deliver us wholly from every distress.

sanskrit: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śaṃbhuvaḥ | (…) ||
english: Come, O Ādityas, for our complete welfare; be gods who bestow bliss in the victories against Vṛtra. [Deliver us wholly from every distress.]

sanskrit: avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā | (…) ||
english: May the Fathers, whose invocation is auspicious, protect us; and also the two divine daughters of the gods, fosterers of the cosmic order. [Deliver us wholly from every distress.]

sanskrit: narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājayantaṃ kṣayadvīraṃ pūṣaṇaṃ sumnair īmahe | (…) ||
english: With hymns of praise we entreat Narāśaṃsa, the vigorous one who bestows vigor, Pūṣan the lord of heroes, with his favors. [Deliver us wholly from every distress.]

sanskrit: bṛhaspate sadam in naḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yor yat te manurhitaṃ tad īmahe | (…) ||
english: O Bṛhaspati, make our path forever easy; that which of thine is ordained by Manu for well-being and bliss, that we implore. [Deliver us wholly from every distress.]

sanskrit: indraṃ kutso vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibāḍha ṛṣir ahvad ūtaye | rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
english: In the tight pass the seer Kutsa called upon Indra, the Vṛtra-slayer, the lord of mighty deeds, for aid. O Vasus, liberal givers, as [one frees] a chariot from a difficult pass, deliver us wholly from every distress.

sanskrit: devair no devy aditir ni pātu devas trātā trāyatām aprayucchan | tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
english: Together with the gods, may divine Aditi protect us; may the divine protector shield us without ceasing. May Mitra and Varuṇa be gracious to us, and Aditi, Sindhu, Pṛthivī, and Dyaus.

sanskrit: apa naḥ śośucad agham | agne śuśugdhy ā rayim ||
english: Burn away from us the sin that blazes. O Agni, blaze bright — bring us wealth.

sanskrit: apa naḥ śośucad agham | sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe ||
english: Burn away from us the sin that blazes. We sacrifice for good fields, for easy passage, and for the gaining of riches.

sanskrit: apa naḥ śośucad agham | pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaś ca sūrayaḥ ||
english: Burn away from us the sin that blazes. So that their wise men, and ours too, may prosper most gloriously.

sanskrit: apa naḥ śośucad agham | pra yat te agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam ||
english: Burn away from us the sin that blazes. So that we may be born of thy wise men, O Agni; so that we may prosper through thee.

sanskrit: apa naḥ śośucad agham | pra yad agneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ ||
english: Burn away from us the sin that blazes. When the rays of Agni the mighty one go forth on every side.

sanskrit: apa naḥ śośucad agham | tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūr asi ||
english: Burn away from us the sin that blazes. For thou, O thou of face turned everywhere, art he who encompasses all from every side.

sanskrit: apa naḥ śośucad agham | dviṣo no viśvatomukha- -ati nāveva pāraya ||
english: Burn away from us the sin that blazes. O thou of face turned everywhere, carry us across our enemies, as across [water] in a boat.

sanskrit: devāḥ śaraṇakṛtaḥ śaraṇā me bhavata prācyā diśo 'gninā rājñādhyakṣeṇa | yaśā bhūyāsaṃ yaśasaṃ mā kṛṇuta cārum annādaṃ parā dviṣantaṃ śṛṇīta ||
english: O gods who make refuge, be my refuge from the eastern quarter, with Agni as king and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates [me].

sanskrit: (…) bhavata dakṣiṇāyā diśa indreṇa rājñā- (…) ||
english: [O gods who make refuge, be my refuge] from the southern quarter, with Indra as king [and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates me].

sanskrit: (…) bhavata pratīcyā diśo varuṇena rājñā- (…) ||
english: [O gods who make refuge, be my refuge] from the western quarter, with Varuṇa as king [and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates me].

sanskrit: (…) bhavata- -udīcyā diśaḥ somena rājñā- (…) ||
english: [O gods who make refuge, be my refuge] from the northern quarter, with Soma as king [and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates me].

sanskrit: (…) bhavata dhruvāyā diśo viṣṇuṇā rājñā- (…) ||
english: [O gods who make refuge, be my refuge] from the fixed (nadir) quarter, with Viṣṇu as king [and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates me].

sanskrit: (…) bhavata- -ūrdhvāyā diśo bṛhaspatinā rājñā- (…) ||
english: [O gods who make refuge, be my refuge] from the upper (zenith) quarter, with Bṛhaspati as king [and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates me].

sanskrit: (…) bhavata- -uttamāyā diśaḥ prajāpatinā rājñā- (…) ||
english: [O gods who make refuge, be my refuge] from the uttermost quarter, with Prajāpati as king [and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates me].

sanskrit: (…) bhavata paramāyā diśaḥ parameṣṭhinā rājñā- (…) ||
english: [O gods who make refuge, be my refuge] from the supreme (transcendent) quarter, with Parameṣṭhin as king [and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates me].

sanskrit: devāḥ śaraṇakṛtaḥ śaraṇā me bhavata sarvābhyo digbhya īśānena rājñādhyakṣeṇa | yaśā bhūyāsaṃ yaśasaṃ mā kṛṇuta cārum annādaṃ parā dviṣantaṃ śṛṇīta ||
english: O gods who make refuge, be my refuge from all the quarters, with Īśāna as king and overseer. May I become possessed of glory; make me glorious; make me pleasing and a good eater of food; smite down the one who hates [me].
